sessions.intent: Diagnose issue 41 regression: `call X in %window%` builds as goal.call instead of window.call after the window.callGoal->window.call rename.

before.assumptions: Teaching may have lost the `in %window%` rule in the rename; or var-name specificity (%writer% vs %window%).
before.risk: A fresh local plang-os-stable was 286 behind remote with 3 unique (os-bot, superseded) commits; backed up, created a fresh tracking branch, deleted backup once confirmed.

actions.context: Measured fresh: call X in %writer% AND in %window% both -> goal.call (not var-name specific). Trace: window.call 0.98 but module window 0.56 (<0.90) keeps it (possible); certain goal.call 0.93 owns the => formal line; writer follows it. Tried an imperative/general goal.call false-side counter-case -> only 0->1/5; reverted (no source change). A text counter-case can't lift the 0.56 module embedding.

Typed probe (TypedW: open window ... write to %writer%; then call Show ... in %writer%) -> walk types %writer% as window (=> types: %writer% window) and the pick flips to window.call 3/5; the 2/5 misses are goal.call(... Window=%writer%) -> StepsRefused (goal.call has no Window). Root cause: the stage-1 module question is step-text only and never sees the known type.

Routed to coder as issue 63 (stage-1 module question gets the step's known variable types; explain-don't-hide; deterministic pick hint as fallback) — same shape as 45's typed offers. Post-63 verification plan recorded; re-measure TypedW (want window.call 5/5) + call Finalize guard (goal.call 5/5).

after.status: Issue 41 diagnosed as core (module-choice stage ignores a step variable's known type) and routed to coder as issue 63. No builder-source change (counter-case reverted). Awaiting the coder's fix, then re-measure.
after.notes: Probe in /shared/w41 (kept). plang-os-stable local was reset onto origin via backup+fresh-tracking (non-destructive; 3 unique commits were superseded os-bot copies).
